The '''Republic First Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It defended [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] during the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]].
